info.title: Sync avatar on access check (@simple-implementation subagent)

parts.text:
Write code in the git worktree /Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden/.worktrees/fix-avatar (branch fix/avatar-sync is checked out; stay on it, do not switch branches). Work ONLY in that directory.

Problem: the user's avatar (`auth_user.image`) is only written at sign-in, so it goes stale when the user changes their Google profile photo. `readWorkspaceProfile` in src/lib/workspace.ts already calls Google's OIDC userinfo endpoint on every access check (via `getReviewAccess` in src/lib/auth.ts, called by every /api/review route), and `identitySchema` already parses an optional `picture` claim. Reuse that to keep the image in sync.

Make these minimal changes:
1. src/lib/workspace.ts `readWorkspaceProfile`: change the final `return profile;` to `return { ...profile, picture: identity.picture ?? profile.thumbnailPhotoUrl };` (the Google photo URL to display).
2. src/lib/auth.ts, getUserInfo: change `image: identity.picture ?? profile.thumbnailPhotoUrl,` to `image: profile.picture,`.
3. src/lib/auth.ts, getReviewAccess: right after `const profile = await readWorkspaceProfile(token.accessToken, account.accountId, true);`, add:
```ts
    if ((profile.picture ?? null) !== session.user.image)
      await db
        .update(schema.user)
        .set({ image: profile.picture ?? null, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(schema.user.id, session.user.id));
```
(`eq`, `db`, `schema` are already imported.) Do not change anything else.

Then run in the worktree: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check` (fix with `pnpm exec oxfmt --write <file>` only on files you touched), `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` (if Next route types are missing run `pnpm exec next typegen` first), and `pnpm test`. Fix only issues caused by your change; check tests/workspace.ts for any assertion on readWorkspaceProfile's return value and update it if it breaks.

Commit with message "Keep the avatar in sync with the Google profile photo" (no Co-Authored-By trailer). Do not push.

Report: full diff and check results.

I made the three changes exactly as specified and committed them on `fix/avatar-sync` as `c634494` ("Keep the avatar in sync with the Google profile photo"). Nothing was pushed, and no branch was switched.

**Diff (`git diff HEAD~1 HEAD`)**
```diff
--- a/src/lib/auth.ts
+++ b/src/lib/auth.ts
@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@ getUserInfo
-              image: identity.picture ?? profile.thumbnailPhotoUrl,
+              image: profile.picture,
@@ -117,6 +117,11 @@ getReviewAccess
     const profile = await readWorkspaceProfile(token.accessToken, account.accountId, true);
+    if ((profile.picture ?? null) !== session.user.image)
+      await db
+        .update(schema.user)
+        .set({ image: profile.picture ?? null, updatedAt: new Date() })
+        .where(eq(schema.user.id, session.user.id));
     stage = "reviewer-role";
--- a/src/lib/workspace.ts
+++ b/src/lib/workspace.ts
@@ -117,7 +117,7 @@ readWorkspaceProfile
-  return profile;
+  return { ...profile, picture: identity.picture ?? profile.thumbnailPhotoUrl };
```

**Checks (run in the worktree)**
- `pnpm lint`: passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm format:check`: passed. No files needed reformatting, so `oxfmt --write` was not run.
- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`: passed, exit 0. Next route typegen was not needed.
- `pnpm test`: passed, exit 0. The only output was pg SSL deprecation warnings.

**Test changes:** none. `tests/workspace.ts` calls `readWorkspaceProfile` only inside `assert.rejects`, so it never asserts on the return value.
